cropharvest.band_availability_explanation: CropHarvest provides pre-extracted time series. The standard 18-band representation includes: B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, B8, B8A, B11, B12, temp, precip, elevation, slope, SAR vv, vh, ratio, and precalculated NDVI. If using a reduced tabular export where only NDVI or crop labels are included, NDMI = (B8 - B11)/(B8 + B11) cannot be directly computed and requires querying raw Sentinel-2 L2A scenes via Copernicus or Planetary Computer.
